# Kie.ai

> Unified API platform providing affordable access to leading AI models for video generation (Veo 3, Runway Gen-4), image editing (FLUX.1 Kontext), chat, and music creation.

Kie.ai offers developers a single RESTful API to integrate multiple AI capabilities including text-to-video generation with Google Veo 3 and Runway Gen-4 Turbo, AI image editing with FLUX.1 Kontext from Black Forest Labs, and other generative AI models. The platform emphasizes affordable pricing, fast video creation, and comprehensive API documentation with support for Python and JavaScript.

## Key Topics

- Veo 3 Fast API
- Runway Gen-4 Turbo API
- FLUX.1 Kontext API
- Text-to-video generation
- AI video creation
- RESTful API integration
- Google AI models (Pro, Ultra)
- Affordable AI pricing
- Video generation API
- Image editing AI
- Developer tools

- Free trial access
- 720p video generation
- Black Forest Labs

## Video Generation APIs

- [Fast and Affordable Veo3 Fast API for Stunning Videos on Kie.ai](https://kie.ai/features/v3-fast-api): Veo3 Fast API transforms text to 8-sec 720p videos with audio

- [API Veo 3 IA Vif et Accessible pour des Vidéos Époustouflantes sur Kie.ai](https://kie.ai/fr/features/v3-fast-api): Veo 3 Fast API for 8-sec 720p video creation from text prompts
- [API de Veo3 Fast rápida y asequible para crear videos impactantes en Kie.ai](https://kie.ai/es/features/v3-fast-api): Veo3 Fast API creates 8-sec 720p videos from text on Kie.ai
- [Быстрый и доступный Veo 3 Fast API для впечатляющих видео на Kie.ai](https://kie.ai/ru/features/v3-fast-api): Veo 3 Fast API creates 8-sec 720p videos from text on Kie.ai
- [Runway Gen-4 Turbo API – Prueba gratuita para la generación rápida y económica de videos con IA](https://kie.ai/es/features/gen4-turbo-api): Runway Gen-4 Turbo API for fast, affordable AI video generation
- [Runway Gen-4 Turbo API – Hızlı ve Uygun Fiyatlı Yapay Zekâ ile Video Oluşturma için Ücretsiz Deneme](https://kie.ai/tr/features/gen4-turbo-api): Runway Gen-4 Turbo API for fast, economical AI video integration
